contracts.declarative.ResourceMetadata.description:
Common metadata for all declarative resources.

# Fields

- `name`: Resource local identifier (resolver input for identity mapping)
- `description`: Human-readable description
- `tags`: Key-value pairs for filtering and organization
- `annotations`: Key-value pairs for extended metadata (not used for filtering)
- `providerRef`: The Provider the resource is filed under

name.description:
Resource name.

This is a service-scoped local identifier used by declarative identity mapping.
The final TRN resource path is resolver-derived and may compose additional
namespace context. Workspace filename matching, if required, is a loader/workspace
policy and not a contracts-level invariant.

tags.description:
Tags for filtering and organization.

Tags are key-value pairs that can be used for:
- Filtering resources in queries
- Organizing resources by environment, team, etc.

annotations.description:
Annotations for extended metadata.

Unlike tags, annotations are not used for filtering.
They're meant for storing additional metadata like:
- Creation tool information
- External system references
- Custom metadata

providerRef.description:
The Provider this resource is filed under, as a ProviderHub Provider
TRN of the resource's own tenant.

It only files the resource for filtering and display; it never
changes how the resource runs. A Provider resource carries none.

contracts.declarative.ResourceTrn.description:
A validated literal TRN reference — the final scalar value of every
declarative reference field.

contracts.declarative.OAuth2ClientAuthor.title: CredVaultOAuth2ClientAuthoringSpec
contracts.declarative.OAuth2ClientAuthor.description:
User-authored OAuth2 Client configuration plus an optional client secret.

This is an ingress-only projection with the same material rules as a
Credential. The loader removes `clientSecret` before the resource enters
managed desired state.

redirectUris.description:
Explicit redirect URI allowlist. Empty means only the platform callback
is allowed; a non-empty list also bounds the platform callback.

scopeOptions.description:
Suggested scopes, unique by exact value. This is neither an allowlist
nor a default selection and does not change existing Authorizations.

pkceEnabled.description:
Enable PKCE for authorization-code flow.

Defaults to `true`.

tokenAuthMethod.description: Token endpoint auth method (e.g., client_secret_post, client_secret_basic)

tokenHeaders.description:
Extra headers to send to the token endpoint; `Authorization` is
rejected because client authentication writes it

tokenParams.description:
Extra form params to send to the token endpoint; `grant_type`, `code`,
`redirect_uri`, `code_verifier`, `refresh_token`, `device_code`,
`client_id` and `client_secret` are rejected because the protocol
writes them

tokenResponse.description:
Optional direct token-fact mapping. Reads response/context; omission
uses the standard OAuth fields. HTTP Content-Type selects decoding.

revocationUrl.description:
RFC 7009 token revocation endpoint. Revoking the Authorization
sends its refresh and access tokens here after the local
revocation commits; without it the provider is not told.

contracts.credvault.OAuth2OidcIdentitySo.description: OIDC has one endpoint authority: exact issuer plus trusted Discovery.

contracts.credvault.OAuth2IdentitySource.description: Ordinary OAuth identifies subjects only through its declared vendor source.

oneOf.description: Mapping from an authenticated vendor response, using RFC 6901 JSON Pointers.
Mapping from an authenticated vendor response, using RFC 6901 JSON Pointers.

contracts.credvault.OAuth2IdentityReques.description: A single provider identity request, authenticated using the new access token.

contracts.declarative.OAuth2ScopeOption.description:
A suggested scope for authoring Authorizations. Values outside this list
remain valid; labels and descriptions are never sent to the provider.

contracts.declarative.OAuth2TokenAuthMet.description: OAuth2 token endpoint client authentication method.

contracts.declarative.OAuth2ClientAuthEn.description: OAuth2 client credential encoding for client_secret_basic.
